sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000103-P1, was presented by the Supplier to Cedar Valley Physician Alliance 103 on December 19, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 3 rebate of 4.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Influenza share floor of 60%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: declined by the Customer.
